name: Munters
description: Kista-based Munters Group sells air, liquid and hybrid cooling for data centres through its Data Center Technologies arm: chillers, CDUs, CRAHs, dry coolers and the Oasis IEC indirect evaporative cooler, which uses a separate air path so no moisture enters the server space.
products: Data-centre chillers, CDUs, CRAHs and dry coolers
notes: 'Adiabatic' is our card's label, not the vendor's: the word does not appear on the pages read. Most munters.com section pages returned a Cloudflare 403; facts come from the corporate root and datacenter.munters.com.

sources.note: Oasis IEC: indirect evaporative cooling without adding moisture, read 2026-11-16
